headlines.title: Chevron CEO warns oil buffers that cushioned the Iran war shock have been ‘drained’—and diesel relief may not come until 2027
headlines.summary: Mike Wirth says commercial stockpiles, emergency reserves, and once-sanctioned barrels have all been tapped, leaving the global energy system more exposed just weeks before the midterms.

headlines.title: Chevron (CVX) Stock Looks Reasonable With Cash Flow Value Above Price
headlines.summary: Chevron has delivered strong share price gains in recent years, and the question now is whether those returns line up with what its cash flows can justify. With the stock recently closing at US$217.73, investors are increasingly focused on how durable the underlying cash generation really is. Over the past 5 years Chevron has returned 138.2%, which puts a lot of weight on the idea that the business can keep producing cash flows that support this higher footing.

headlines.title: Chevron vs. ExxonMobil: Which Energy Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
headlines.summary: ExxonMobil's 8.9% net margin outpaces Chevron's 6.7%, but Chevron's Guyana expansion could reshape the competitive landscape.

headlines.title: These 3 Oil Giants Make Money Beyond the Wellhead. That’s Good News for Dividends
headlines.summary: Oil prices crashed 14% last year, yet three energy giants kept raising their dividends anyway. The integrated business model behind that trick also explains why analysts see one of them as the most recession-proof income stock in the sector.

headlines.title: Morningstar’s Dividend ETF Is Kind of Perfect for Retirees Right Now
headlines.summary: FDL has handed retirees growing income and strong returns for nearly two decades, but the fund comes with a concentrated bet and a quarterly payout quirk that can wreck a fixed expense budget if you are not prepared for it.

description: Chevron Corporation, through its subsidiaries, engages in the integrated energy and chemicals operations. It operates through Upstream and Downstream segments. The Upstream segment engages in the exploration for, development, production, and transportation of crude oil and natural gas; processing, liquefaction, transportation, and regasification of liquefied natural gas; transportation of crude oil through pipelines; transportation, storage, and marketing of natural gas; carbon capture and storage; and operation of a gas-to-liquids plant. The Downstream segment refines crude oil into petroleum products; markets crude oil, refined products, and lubricants; manufactures and markets renewable fuels; transports crude oil and refined products through pipeline, marine vessel, motor equipment, and rail car; and manufactures and markets commodity petrochemicals, plastics for industrial uses, and fuel and lubricant additives. The company operates in North America, South America, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Australia. The company was formerly known as ChevronTexaco Corporation and changed its name to Chevron Corporation in May 2005. Chevron Corporation was founded in 1879 and is headquartered in Houston, Texas.
